arithmetic: fractions.Fraction throughout; logarithms enclosed by exact rational series after powers-of-two range reduction

negative_control_uncovered_roots.result: An unbalanced baseline does not prove the proposed uniform multi-root inequality.

controls.negative_control_route_addressable_gatin: Baseline suppressed, added route enabled: q0=1, q1=0, so one endpoint distinguishes the hard pair. This action is excluded.
controls.negative_control_shared_random_gates: One reused Bernoulli gate per root gives q0=q1=1/4 at r=2,k=2,a=(1/2,1/2); independent-route laws give 1/16 and 3/64.
controls.negative_control_variance_floor: Exact near-zero and near-one rate sequences have variance bounded by quantities tending to zero; there is no uniform positive variance floor.
controls.negative_control_confidence_half: Certified ratios kl(1-delta,delta)/log(1/delta) < 10/j^2 at delta=(j-1)/(2j), j=10,100,1000.

limitations: Finite controls supplement the written analytic proof; they do not replace it.
